items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Ever hear about Professor James Follett or Jimmy Follett? ... INTERVIEWEE: I don't know his name. I don't know his name.

ctx.x: Was that the first horn you ever had?

That's the first horn I ever bought. You see the first time I started to play it was the ghetto. I played ghetto a while and it was too slow and I went and bought a violin. And I went to Jimmy, take a lesson with Jimmy, we used to call him Jimmy Sprig, but he named Jimmy Pallard. Well I take a lesson with him. He used to take a lesson with the professor before those French Opry went down. You know, we used to have a French Opry here right on Toulouse Street there. You don't remember that. No, but I was saying he…
Business was slow on those instruments?
